args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money per FIN-212

The docstring claimed banker's rounding but the implementation used
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing the nightly test (tests/test_money.py) to fail.
Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.head: fix/money-round-half-even
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` implemented half-up rounding instead.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP` in `round_money`'s `quantize` call, matching the existing docstring behavior required by FIN-212.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed, including `tests/test_money.py`.
